lines.t: My sons and daughters from the beginning, I am who I am, and shall be even to the end, I, I am here from the everlasting to everlasting, I am, and this shall you find rest, and no peace, says the Lord.
Therefore no longer bind yourselves to what you see
Nor concern yourselves with the things of this world and its evil ways
Free yourselves by the knowledge I have given you
By the understanding that I am who I am
Freedom in the knowing I am
He beloved ones, I have defeated the world
I have overcome your sins
Death is put to death because of me
Behold, I am risen
Death is turned backward
Only life lives and shall be
Lo, I have defeated you also
If you would only surrender your life
For I gave up my life in place of yours
So you may receive of my life
Therefore I ask you
How long were you with all?
How long were you awake before you let go?
When will you fly? When will you believe? Believe, and you shall also know
For I have already told you pieces in the knowing
That I am who I am, and you are in life because of me
The love that you were made for me, created for love's purpose
I created you in my image and gave you my breath
My life, therefore this is life
I am here, beloved you worry
Yet I am here, you weep
Yet I am here, you stumble
Yet I am here, your hearts tear and break over all these sorrows
Yet I am here, you struggle
And are internal, you feel lost
Yet I am here, you grasp at the wind
And have no understanding
Yet I am he
You are persecuted by those you love
Yet I am he
You are persecuted by those you love
Yet I am he
The world hates you, yet I am he
Everything you have is passing away, yet I am he
Death comes to take you into darkness, yet I am he
If you do not understand, I am enough
The one who sees, the one who knows
No matter the time or the season
In every moment of your life, I am here
Says the Lord
